aisha: Quick: Foxglove week0 private onboarding blocked by two items: TGW routes not propagating to two child RTs, and KMS decrypt failures stopping SIEM forwarding.

ben-csm: their team is on the call in 10. Need a short list to unblock.

dana-sre: TGW attachment tgw-attach-0cafe123 shows propagate=false on rt-0aa11bb. I'll flip propagate=true and recheck.

oliver-ops: forwarder logs show: "AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt alias/fox-logs" after yesterday's rotation. FoxSec doesn't want key policy edits. Can we create a short-lived grant?

dana-sre: yes — recommend a 24h grant for arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rwd-forwarder-role to unblock smoke. I'll create it and trigger a forwarder test.

@deploy-bot: scheduled: invoke-forwarder-smoke for foxglove at 2024-06-25T20:30:00Z.

dana-sre: TGW propagate change applied. Traceroute now reaches infra hop. Creating temp KMS grant g-3f2e1d.

oliver-ops: forwarder test executed; Decrypt=SUCCESS, event landed in fox-soc-smoke. SIEM confirmed. Marking audit-forwarding=smoke-green.

ben-csm: great. Two asks for Foxglove: (1) SOC to confirm long-term key policy or automation for grants, (2) confirm TGW infra changes committed to their terraform.

aisha: tagging renewals: account utilization 17% of commit; renewal risk=medium if onboarding >10 days. Recommend weekly exec checks until usage recovers.

renewals-bot: noted; will follow up in 48h.

foxglove-bot (external): "Thanks 1 Reviewing temp grant and will get SecOps to propose a permanent approach by EOD PT."

aisha: summary: TGW propagate fixed ✅, temp KMS grant created ✅ (forwarder smoke green), pending: FoxSec sign-off for permanent CMK approach. I'll update the runbook and CRM.
